findings.documented: The endpoint documents a total record count and a maximum page size of 200.
findings.actual: The API returned limit=50 even when limit=200 was requested. Offset pagination retrieved 4100 records although responses reported total=3844.
findings.how_found: Fetched /v1/listings without filters and paged by offset until has_more=false. offset=3800 returned count=50,total=3844,has_more=true; offset=4050 returned count=50,total=3844,has_more=false.
findings.impact: Clients relying on the documented page size or reported total may fetch less efficiently or stop early and miss 256 records.

findings.documented: The endpoint reports a total count of project records.
findings.actual: The API reported total=431, but paging until has_more=false retrieved 460 unique projects.
findings.how_found: Fetched the projects endpoint through all available offsets and compared the reported total with the number of unique project IDs retrieved.
findings.impact: Clients trusting the reported total may stop pagination early and miss 29 projects.

findings.documented: The endpoint reports a total number of rental records.
findings.actual: For the assigned Anna Nagar locality, the API reported total=141 but exposed 150 retrievable records across offsets 0, 50 and 100.
findings.how_found: Requested Anna Nagar rentals with limit=200 and then paged offsets 0, 50, 100 and 150. Offsets 0, 50 and 100 returned 50 records each; offset 150 returned 0.
findings.impact: The reported total is inconsistent with retrievable records and can cause incorrect counts or premature termination.

findings.documented: Project records include a reported listing count.
findings.actual: 336 of 460 projects have a reported total_listings value that differs from the actual number of listing records associated with the project.
findings.how_found: Compared each project's reported total_listings against the count of retrievable listing records grouped by project.
findings.impact: Project listing counts displayed to users can be incorrect.

findings.documented: Listing records contain property and pricing information.
findings.actual: 18 retrievable records contain impossible property data, including negative prices or floor numbers greater than total floors.
findings.how_found: Validated retrievable listing records for impossible numeric property values.
findings.impact: Corrupt records can produce invalid listings, prices and analytics.

findings.actual: A high-confidence set of 90 MAG listing records has implausibly tiny carpet areas relative to matching normal-area listings with the same core property characteristics.
findings.how_found: Compared bedroom-specific tiny-area records against matching listings using property name/locality/core attributes and identified records with area ratios below 20% of the corresponding normal-area listing.
findings.impact: These records can distort search results, pricing analytics and user trust.
